title: For coaches
description: A private page for every player, video tagging and analysis, a tactics board with your players' faces, messages and lesson booking, and a community where players find you.
heading: For coaches
line: A private page for every player, the tools to coach them, and a community where players find you.

heroShot.alt: The coach dashboard on a phone, one card per player

features.heading: A page for every player
features.body: Each player gets a private page with your session notes, homework, ratings, fitness tests and clips. Your own notes stay private, and your dashboard shows who has been active and what is new.

shot.alt: A player's page on the coach dashboard, Sessions tab

features.heading: Match Tagger
features.body: Tag a match from the video as you watch and the score, winners and errors build as you go, ready to filter by player, shot or game.

shot.alt: The Match Tagger with a tagged match and its report

features.heading: Technique Analyser
features.body: Step through a stroke frame by frame, draw on it and send the frame to your player.

shot.alt: The Technique Analyser stepping through a stroke

features.heading: Tactics Board
features.body: Draw a play with your players' faces on the court, add text and a voice-over, and share it to their page. Each play keeps its last ten versions, so you can always go back.

shot.alt: The Tactics Board with a play drawn on the court

features.heading: Messages, homework and booking
features.body: Message each player with text, voice notes, links and clips, and set homework they tick off as they go. Book their next lesson, see who is coming, and get a morning email with the day's lessons.

shot.alt: Messages with a player on the coach page, on a phone

features.heading: Ask a coach and your public profile
features.body: Answer players' questions in the Community, from your own area and club first. Answers they mark as helping show on your public profile, with a button for players to ask to join you.

shot.alt: A coach's public profile: players helped in Ask a coach, and a button to ask them to coach you

faq.a: Yes. A coach account is free. It comes with a set number of player spots and clip storage, and you can ask for more from Your plan in Settings.

faq.q: Do my players need an account?
faq.a: No. Each player's page opens from a private link, with nothing to sign up for. Players who set up a free account can link it to you, send you clips and keep their own stats.

faq.q: Does it work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. It runs in the browser on a phone, tablet or computer, so there is nothing to install. The Match Tagger is the exception: it needs a laptop or computer.

Videos and clips on a player's page are seen by you, that player and anyone they share their private link with. Nothing is public unless you post it in the Community. A video you tag from a file on your computer never leaves it.

faq.q: How do I get my players on?
faq.a: Add a player and send them the link to their page, or share your invite link so they set up their own account already linked to you.
